flags.why: In thụ tinh and thụ phấn, thụ means receiving, not performing fertilization or pollination.
flags.fix: Merge with sense 1 under 'to receive'; remove the separate 'to fertilize; to pollinate' sense.

flags.why: The example explains the Buddhist classification of thụ instead of showing a feeling being experienced or observed.
flags.fix: Khi thiền, hành giả quan sát các thụ sinh khởi rồi biến mất. = During meditation, the practitioner observes feelings arising and then disappearing.

flags.why: Chánh án identifies a chief or presiding judge, rather than a separate archaic meaning of any judge or magistrate ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ch%C3%A1nh%20%C3%A1n)).
